transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.closedBody: Signings, sales and bids are only possible during a window. For now you can scout players, renew contracts and release players.
transfers.offer.contested: Competitive bidding · Interested clubs: {clubs}. He'll decide after the Round {round} matches, weighing the signing-on fee and each club's stature. Agent's tip: you'll need {low}–{high} to be in with a chance.
transfers.offer.freeAsk: Free agent: no transfer fee, but he wants a signing-on fee of at least {asking}.
transfers.loanIn.intentYoung: {team} want him to get regular game time to develop. He returns at the end of the season.
transfers.loanIn.intentWage: {team} want to ease the wages of a player sitting on their bench. He returns at the end of the season.
transfers.loanIn.title: Loan in {name}
transfers.loanIn.untilEnd: Until the end of the season
transfers.loanOut.noClub: No club wants him as a regular starter.
transfers.loanOut.title: Loan out {name}
transfers.loanOut.note: Until the end of the season · the receiving club pays part of his wages · he develops with every match he plays there
transfers.sell.justSigned: Signed in this window. He can be sold from the next window.
transfers.sell.noInterest: No clubs are interested in this player.
transfers.sell.title: Sell {name}
transfers.legend.overBudget: Red fee: beyond your current budget
